refs.label: UTHealth/MH Master Workup CPG

Programme companion CPG; disease-specific protocols control eligibility, treatment, exception requests and surveillance. Hepatic adenoma row of the disease-specific minimum staging matrix: liver MRI with hepatobiliary characterisation, haemorrhage and rupture history, subtype and genetic-syndrome evaluation where relevant; confirm the diagnosis and exclude malignant transformation where tissue or a resection specimen exists; allocation pathway non-standard review with no automatic entitlement. Draft for institutional review. Companion protocol set reviewed 20 July 2026.

refs.label: NCCN Ampullary Adenocarcinoma
refs.cite: National Comprehensive Cancer Network. Ampullary Adenocarcinoma. NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology. Programme-supplied machine-converted extraction, consulted 6 October 2026; the extraction carries no version string on any page, so the edition in force must be confirmed before this page is published. Pages used: clinical presentation, workup and treatment algorithms for ampullary adenoma and adenocarcinoma; postoperative adjuvant treatment and surveillance; Principles of Stent Management; Principles of Surgical Technique; Pathologic Analysis including Histologic Subtyping; Principles of Systemic Therapy (neoadjuvant, adjuvant, metastatic); Principles of Radiation Therapy; AJCC tables; and the Discussion. Known defect: the Principles of Systemic Therapy adjuvant page states that ESPAC-3 demonstrated significant improvements in disease-free and overall survival with adjuvant gemcitabine or fluorouracil versus observation in resectable ampullary adenocarcinoma, and quotes median survivals of 23.0 and 23.6 months for fluorouracil-leucovorin and gemcitabine — neither claim matches the published periampullary trial (PMID 22782416), and those medians correspond to the ESPAC-3 pancreatic cohort. The guideline's own Discussion states the position correctly. Confirm against the published PDF before quoting. The full-text read of ESPAC-3 on 7 October 2026 confirms the discrepancy from the trial side: the published periampullary trial reports no significant disease-free or overall survival result for ampullary adenocarcinoma, adjusted or otherwise, because the ampullary subgroup was never powered and no hypothesis test for it was performed.

refs.label: NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
refs.cite: National Comprehensive Cancer Network. Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma. NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology. Programme-supplied machine-converted extraction, consulted 6 October 2026; no version string in the extraction. Used for the operative and specimen questions ampullary disease shares with pancreatic cancer: the 1 mm margin convention and its acknowledged extrapolation from rectal cancer data, the SMA (retroperitoneal, uncinate) margin and specimen inking, the randomised and meta-analytic evidence against extended lymphadenectomy, and the minimum-lymph-node-yield proposals of 11 to 17.

The summary tables were used for this draft; the full supplement should be read before the page is ratified.
